detail.headline: Poetry for People Who Hate Poetry - October « Kenyon Review Blog
detail.excerpt: Poetry for People Who Hate Poetry – October By Dave Lucas In the beginning was the Word, I read again, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. Whatever your theology, that’s a sublime lede. We call this anonymous text the Gospel of John.
